mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metrics ( metric_name VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY, raw_val DOUBLE NOT NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT metric_name, raw_val, LN(raw_val) AS ln_val, EXP(raw_val) AS exp_val, TRUNC(raw_val, 2) AS trunc_val, INITCAP(metric_name) AS initcap_str, REGEXP_REPLACE(metric_name, 'cpu', 'processor') AS replaced_str, CASE WHEN metric_name ~ '^cpu_[0-9]+' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS regex_matched FROM metrics ORDER BY metric_name ASC

SELECT metric_name, raw_val, LN(raw_val) AS ln_val, EXP(raw_val) AS exp_val, TRUNC(raw_val, 2) AS trunc_val, INITCAP(metric_name) AS initcap_str, metric_name AS replaced_str, TRUE AS regex_matched FROM metrics WHERE metric_name ~ #{pattern} ORDER BY metric_name ASC
